direct.docTitle: Likwiid Direct: Commission-Free Direct Booking Engine
direct.heroTitle: Bookings that flow straight to you.
direct.heroSubtitle: Likwiid Direct is a direct booking engine for small stays and experiences. No commission, no middleman, no lock-in. You keep your domain, your payment account and your guest list.
direct.audience: Built for small hotels, guesthouses, tour operators, salons and clinics.
direct.demoNote: Quinta Likwiid and Atelier Likwiid are fictional. They exist so you can click through the exact engine we would build for you. The checkout is simulated and no payment is taken.
direct.feature1Desc: A tasting for two, an airport transfer, an extra night. Guests tick what they want and watch the total and the deposit update in front of them.
direct.feature2Title: A deposit, not the full amount
direct.feature2Desc: Most small properties already ask for 20 or 30 percent by bank transfer. Likwiid Direct takes the same deposit by card, at the exact moment the guest decides, and the balance stays payable on arrival.
direct.feature3Title: It lives inside the site you already have
direct.feature3Desc: One script tag and one div on any WordPress, Wix or hand-built site. No rebuild, no migration. Your website stays yours and the bookings come straight to you.
direct.feature4Desc: Every step, every label and every price in the language the guest picks. Nothing half translated and nothing leaking internal labels.
direct.feature5Title: Places left, and a waitlist when a slot is full
direct.feature5Desc: Classes, tours and sessions carry a capacity per time. Guests see how many places are left, and when a slot is full they can join the waitlist instead of leaving.
direct.feature6Title: Your rules, applied before anyone asks
direct.feature6Desc: Minimum and maximum stays, the notice you need, days kept free between bookings, seasonal prices and closed periods. The calendar only offers what you would accept.
direct.feature7Title: Your terms, agreed before anything is sent
direct.feature7Desc: Your cancellation and payment terms sit at the last step, and nobody can book or send a request without ticking that they have read them.
direct.feature8Title: An owner panel in your brand
direct.feature8Desc: Requests to approve or decline, a reservation list with search and export, a calendar you block with one click, your guests and their credits, and your texts and prices. You edit all of it yourself.
direct.scarcity: This engine is not running anyone's bookings yet, so the first property gets a reference price in exchange for letting us show the finished work. If a platform already serves you well and the commission does not bother you, this product is not for you.
direct.demoPreviewAlt: Preview of the Likwiid Direct booking flow
direct.syncBody: Likwiid Direct imports the busy dates from the calendars you already use. Any platform that can export an iCal feed works, and those dates close here automatically. It also exports a feed for each unit, so a direct booking closes the date everywhere else you list. In the live demo the synced calendar is sample data. Syncs are not instant: feeds refresh on a schedule, and the calendar shows when it last synced, so you always know how fresh the busy dates are.
direct.requestBody: Likwiid Direct runs in request mode for owners who confirm every booking themselves. A visitor picks dates, party size and extras, sees an estimated total, and sends it to you. Nothing is booked and no payment is taken. The enquiry arrives with everything you would otherwise have to ask for, and you confirm, suggest another time or decline, exactly as you do today.
direct.requestNote: When you want bookings to confirm themselves, switch to instant booking with a card deposit from your owner panel. Same page, same calendar.
direct.ownerMockWeekdays: M T W T F S S
direct.ownerCaption: An illustration of the owner view.
direct.siteBody: We also design and build the full website around it: design, build and launch, mobile-first, in 2 to 4 weeks.
direct.siteItem5: Training so your team can run it
direct.siteItem6: A real person who replies within 24 hours
direct.proofBody: We have built this before: a court booking platform where players book and pay from their phone, and the owners run everything from one dashboard.
direct.proofLink: See the padel booking case study

frame.docTitle: Likwiid Frame: Photographer Portfolio Website You Own
frame.heroTitle: A portfolio you own, down to the files.
frame.heroSubtitle: Likwiid Frame is a portfolio engine for photographers, with client proofing, a print shop and booking built in. You pay once, keep your own domain and own the site as files, with no subscription.
frame.demoNote: Ana Likwiid Photography and Studio Likwiid are fictional: one engine, two brands that look like different studios. Proofing and checkout are simulated and no payment is taken.
frame.demoCard1PreviewAlt: Preview of Ana Likwiid Photography, a wedding portfolio built with Likwiid Frame
frame.demoCard2PreviewAlt: Preview of Studio Likwiid, an art and commercial portfolio built with Likwiid Frame
frame.adminTitle: And the part only you see
frame.adminBody: Every Frame site ships with an owner panel in your brand: reorder galleries, publish photos, edit texts and prices, follow proofing and review print orders.
frame.painBody: Portfolio platforms rent you your own work. The subscription climbs every year, and leaving means starting over, because your galleries, client selections and search ranking stay on their servers. Frame is delivered as files you own, on your own domain, with nothing to renew.
frame.pipelineNote: Every photo is served at the right size in modern formats, with your copyright details kept, so pages load fast and image search credits you.
frame.feature3Desc: Each client gets a private gallery to pick favourites, leave notes on photos and submit a selection that respects the number included in their package.
frame.feature4Title: A print shop, ready to wire up
frame.feature4Desc: Mark images for sale with sizes and prices, and clients order prints through a cart that connects to your own payment account.
frame.feature5Desc: On Ana's contact page, the booking calendar is Likwiid Direct, our booking engine, embedded live. The two products work together, and neither depends on the other.
frame.feature6Desc: Multi-language sites, European Portuguese included, with page titles and structured data set up so search engines understand your name, your city and your images.
frame.priceIntro: Pay once, with no subscription, no commission and no per-booking fee. The exact figure depends on how many galleries and languages you need. Hosting is yours and usually free or close to it.
frame.tier1Desc: The public portfolio: galleries, about, services and contact pages, on your own domain, delivered as files you own.
frame.tier2Desc: Everything in Portfolio, plus client proofing, the print shop and the booking embed.
frame.scarcity: This engine is not running any photographer's portfolio yet, so the first real one gets the lower end of that band in exchange for letting us show the finished work. If a platform subscription already serves you well, that is a fine way to run a studio, and this product is not for you.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.collectBody: When you use our contact form, we collect the information you provide: your name, email address, company name (if provided), and message content. We do not collect any information automatically beyond what is strictly necessary for the website to function.
privacy.useBody: We use the information you submit through our contact form solely to respond to your inquiry and discuss potential projects. We will not send you marketing communications unless you have explicitly opted in to receive them.
privacy.sharingBody: We do not sell, trade, or share your personal information with third parties. Your data stays with us and is used exclusively for the purpose it was provided.
privacy.cookiesBody: We only use essential browser storage. We keep your theme preference, light or dark, and your language choice in localStorage, and during a single visit we keep any campaign tags from the link you followed in sessionStorage. We do not use any tracking cookies or third-party cookies.
privacy.analyticsBody: We use privacy-friendly analytics, Umami, hosted on our own server, that do not use cookies and do not track personal data. We count page views and clicks on buttons such as the contact button or a demo launch, and we honour your browser's Do Not Track setting. If you arrive through a link with campaign tags, we keep those tags and the page you landed on in your browser's sessionStorage for the length of your visit, and send them with the contact form so we know how you found us. Nothing in this identifies you, and your browsing is not tracked across websites.
privacy.retentionBody: Contact form submissions are retained for legitimate business purposes, such as maintaining records of client communications and project discussions. We keep this data only as long as necessary for these purposes.
privacy.rightsBody: You have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of any personal data we hold about you. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at
privacy.updatesBody: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected on this page with an updated revision date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
privacy.contactBody: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or how we handle your data, please reach out at
